verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a 'Create a custom control' API alongside adding controls from its built-in library. Custom Tests turn pushed data from homegrown systems into pass/fail evidence, and documents can be mapped to controls as evidence. Marketing also says controls can be cross-mapped across pre-built frameworks 'or ones you've customized', and that you can bring your existing program. Missing for 10: explicit documentation for creating a wholly new custom framework (the evidence only says 'customized'), detailed docs on defining per-control evidence requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
